Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Interface Callable

All Known Subinterfaces:
HostFunction
All Known Implementing Classes:
HostFunction.Adaptor, MandelaClass, MandelaClosure
public interface Callable
Marker for every Mandela value that can be called: a script closure, a bound method, or a function the host contributed.

The virtual machine dispatches calls through this interface, which is what lets a Java (or Kotlin) lambda sit in the same global table as a script function and be indistinguishable to the author: println and upper are natives, fib is a closure, and user code calls both identically.
